hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The promise
hits.text:
## The promise
If a customer takes AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at the full recommended dose for at least six consecutive months and their follow up DEXA scan does not show an increase in bone density in either the hip or the spine, AlgaeCal refunds every penny paid for those two products between the two scans. The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: Common edge cases
hits.text: Common edge cases: Improvement in one site but not the other: the guarantee is met if hip OR spine increased. A customer whose spine improved and hip stayed flat does not qualify for the refund.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium and DEXA
hits.text:
## Strontium and DEXA
Strontium is heavier than calcium, so once it is in the bone a DEXA scan reads higher than the real change in bone mineral. The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. When a customer asks about this, say it plainly and point out that the guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: How to claim
hits.text:
## How to claim
Contact Customer Care by phone (1-800-820-0184) or email (support@algaecal.com) with both DEXA reports. The refund is for AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost purchased from AlgaeCal between the two scan dates.

hits.text:
## Strontium
Strontium Boost is strontium citrate, not the prescription drug strontium ranelate that was linked to heart risk in Europe. AlgaeCal's position is that strontium citrate has a different safety record. Customers with heart disease, kidney disease or blood clotting history should talk to their doctor before taking it.

hits.heading: How long until a scan shows change
hits.text:
## How long until a scan shows change
The published studies and the guarantee both use six months as the minimum. Most follow up scans are 12 to 24 months apart because insurance pays for them on that schedule. Typical reported increases are 1% to 4% in the first six to twelve months. Individual results vary.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

hits.heading: The promise
hits.text:

If a customer takes AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at the full recommended dose for at least six consecutive months and their follow up DEXA scan does not show an increase in bone density in either the hip or the spine, AlgaeCal refunds every penny paid for those two products between the two scans. The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

Donna,

AlgaeCal's Stronger Bones For Life guarantee is based on the Dual-Energy X-ray Absorptiometry (DEXA) scan results, which measure Bone Mineral Density (BMD). The guarantee does not specifically mention Trabecular Bone Score (TBS). However, we do have data on TBS, and it is considered a complementary measure of bone health.

AlgaeCal Customer Care.

hits.heading: Common side effects
hits.text:
## Common side effects
Digestive upset and constipation are the ones customers report most, usually from the magnesium or from taking all capsules at once. Splitting the dose and taking with food helps. Anything that feels serious: stop and see a doctor.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Lead and heavy metals
hits.text:
## Lead and heavy metals
Every batch is third party tested for heavy metals. In September 2026 a California Proposition 65 notice was filed relating to lead in a product. Prop 65 thresholds are far below federal limits and many whole food calcium supplements carry the notice. Customer Care should acknowledge the notice, point to the batch testing, and not argue with the customer.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Medication interactions people ask about
hits.text:
## Medication interactions people ask about
Levothyroxine (space four hours), bisphosphonates like Fosamax (customers often take both, ask them to involve their doctor), Prolia (same), blood thinners (vitamin K2 is in the product, so warfarin users must speak to their doctor first).

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium and DEXA
hits.text:
## Strontium and DEXA
Strontium is heavier than calcium, so once it is in the bone a DEXA scan reads higher than the real change in bone mineral. The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. When a customer asks about this, say it plainly and point out that the guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured.

hits.heading: How long until a scan shows change
hits.text:
## How long until a scan shows change
The published studies and the guarantee both use six months as the minimum. Most follow up scans are 12 to 24 months apart because insurance pays for them on that schedule. Typical reported increases are 1% to 4% in the first six to twelve months. Individual results vary.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: Common edge cases
hits.text: Common edge cases: Different clinic or machine: scans are not directly comparable. Customer Care can still review, but the published terms ask for the same clinic.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The promise
hits.text:
## The promise
If a customer takes AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at the full recommended dose for at least six consecutive months and their follow up DEXA scan does not show an increase in bone density in either the hip or the spine, AlgaeCal refunds every penny paid for those two products between the two scans. The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.heading: Strontium
hits.text:
## Strontium
Strontium Boost is strontium citrate, not the prescription drug strontium ranelate that was linked to heart risk in Europe. AlgaeCal's position is that strontium citrate has a different safety record. Customers with heart disease, kidney disease or blood clotting history should talk to their doctor before taking it.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium and DEXA
hits.text:
## Strontium and DEXA
Strontium is heavier than calcium, so once it is in the bone a DEXA scan reads higher than the real change in bone mineral. The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. When a customer asks about this, say it plainly and point out that the guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Common side effects
hits.text:
## Common side effects
Digestive upset and constipation are the ones customers report most, usually from the magnesium or from taking all capsules at once. Splitting the dose and taking with food helps. Anything that feels serious: stop and see a doctor.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Lead and heavy metals
hits.text:
## Lead and heavy metals
Every batch is third party tested for heavy metals. In September 2026 a California Proposition 65 notice was filed relating to lead in a product. Prop 65 thresholds are far below federal limits and many whole food calcium supplements carry the notice. Customer Care should acknowledge the notice, point to the batch testing, and not argue with the customer.

The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. When a customer asks about this, say it plainly and point out that the guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured.

hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The promise
hits.text:
## The promise
If a customer takes AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at the full recommended dose for at least six consecutive months and their follow up DEXA scan does not show an increase in bone density in either the hip or the spine, AlgaeCal refunds every penny paid for those two products between the two scans. The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: What it covers
hits.text:
## What it covers
The guarantee covers AlgaeCal Plus taken together with Strontium Boost (sold together as the Bone Builder Pack). AlgaeCal basic, Collagen, D3 Complete, Magnesium Relax and Triple Power are not covered by the bone density guarantee. They fall under the one year money back policy instead.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: How to claim
hits.text:
## How to claim
Contact Customer Care by phone (1-800-820-0184) or email (support@algaecal.com) with both DEXA reports. The refund is for AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost purchased from AlgaeCal between the two scan dates.

hits.heading: Common side effects
hits.text:
## Common side effects
Digestive upset and constipation are the ones customers report most, usually from the magnesium or from taking all capsules at once. Splitting the dose and taking with food helps. Anything that feels serious: stop and see a doctor.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Medication interactions people ask about
hits.text:
## Medication interactions people ask about
Levothyroxine (space four hours), bisphosphonates like Fosamax (customers often take both, ask them to involve their doctor), Prolia (same), blood thinners (vitamin K2 is in the product, so warfarin users must speak to their doctor first).

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Lead and heavy metals
hits.text:
## Lead and heavy metals
Every batch is third party tested for heavy metals. In September 2026 a California Proposition 65 notice was filed relating to lead in a product. Prop 65 thresholds are far below federal limits and many whole food calcium supplements carry the notice. Customer Care should acknowledge the notice, point to the batch testing, and not argue with the customer.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium and DEXA
hits.text:
## Strontium and DEXA
Strontium is heavier than calcium, so once it is in the bone a DEXA scan reads higher than the real change in bone mineral. The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. When a customer asks about this, say it plainly and point out that the guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: How long until a scan shows change
hits.text:
## How long until a scan shows change
The published studies and the guarantee both use six months as the minimum. Most follow up scans are 12 to 24 months apart because insurance pays for them on that schedule. Typical reported increases are 1% to 4% in the first six to twelve months. Individual results vary.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The promise
hits.text:
## The promise
If a customer takes AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at the full recommended dose for at least six consecutive months and their follow up DEXA scan does not show an increase in bone density in either the hip or the spine, AlgaeCal refunds every penny paid for those two products between the two scans. The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium and DEXA
hits.text:
## Strontium and DEXA
Strontium is heavier than calcium, so once it is in the bone a DEXA scan reads higher than the real change in bone mineral. The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. When a customer asks about this, say it plainly and point out that the guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured.

hits.heading: How long until a scan shows change
hits.text:
## How long until a scan shows change
The published studies and the guarantee both use six months as the minimum. Most follow up scans are 12 to 24 months apart because insurance pays for them on that schedule. Typical reported increases are 1% to 4% in the first six to twelve months. Individual results vary.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The promise
hits.text:
## The promise
If a customer takes AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at the full recommended dose for at least six consecutive months and their follow up DEXA scan does not show an increase in bone density in either the hip or the spine, AlgaeCal refunds every penny paid for those two products between the two scans. The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.heading: Strontium
hits.text:
## Strontium
Strontium Boost is strontium citrate, not the prescription drug strontium ranelate that was linked to heart risk in Europe. AlgaeCal's position is that strontium citrate has a different safety record. Customers with heart disease, kidney disease or blood clotting history should talk to their doctor before taking it.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium and DEXA
hits.text:
## Strontium and DEXA
Strontium is heavier than calcium, so once it is in the bone a DEXA scan reads higher than the real change in bone mineral. The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. When a customer asks about this, say it plainly and point out that the guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Medication interactions people ask about
hits.text:
## Medication interactions people ask about
Levothyroxine (space four hours), bisphosphonates like Fosamax (customers often take both, ask them to involve their doctor), Prolia (same), blood thinners (vitamin K2 is in the product, so warfarin users must speak to their doctor first).

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Common side effects
hits.text:
## Common side effects
Digestive upset and constipation are the ones customers report most, usually from the magnesium or from taking all capsules at once. Splitting the dose and taking with food helps. Anything that feels serious: stop and see a doctor.

## Strontium
Strontium Boost is strontium citrate, not the prescription drug strontium ranelate that was linked to heart risk in Europe. AlgaeCal's position is that strontium citrate has a different safety record. Customers with heart disease, kidney disease or blood clotting history should talk to their doctor before taking it.

hits.heading: Common side effects
hits.text:
## Common side effects
Digestive upset and constipation are the ones customers report most, usually from the magnesium or from taking all capsules at once. Splitting the dose and taking with food helps. Anything that feels serious: stop and see a doctor.

Levothyroxine (space four hours), bisphosphonates like Fosamax (customers often take both, ask them to involve their doctor), Prolia (same), blood thinners (vitamin K2 is in the product, so warfarin users must speak to their doctor first).

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Lead and heavy metals
hits.text:
## Lead and heavy metals
Every batch is third party tested for heavy metals. In September 2026 a California Proposition 65 notice was filed relating to lead in a product. Prop 65 thresholds are far below federal limits and many whole food calcium supplements carry the notice. Customer Care should acknowledge the notice, point to the batch testing, and not argue with the customer.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: How long until a scan shows change
hits.text:
## How long until a scan shows change
The published studies and the guarantee both use six months as the minimum. Most follow up scans are 12 to 24 months apart because insurance pays for them on that schedule. Typical reported increases are 1% to 4% in the first six to twelve months. Individual results vary.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The promise
hits.text:
## The promise
If a customer takes AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at the full recommended dose for at least six consecutive months and their follow up DEXA scan does not show an increase in bone density in either the hip or the spine, AlgaeCal refunds every penny paid for those two products between the two scans. The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium and DEXA
hits.text:
## Strontium and DEXA
Strontium is heavier than calcium, so once it is in the bone a DEXA scan reads higher than the real change in bone mineral. The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. When a customer asks about this, say it plainly and point out that the guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The promise
hits.text:
## The promise
If a customer takes AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at the full recommended dose for at least six consecutive months and their follow up DEXA scan does not show an increase in bone density in either the hip or the spine, AlgaeCal refunds every penny paid for those two products between the two scans. The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: How long until a scan shows change
hits.text:
## How long until a scan shows change
The published studies and the guarantee both use six months as the minimum. Most follow up scans are 12 to 24 months apart because insurance pays for them on that schedule. Typical reported increases are 1% to 4% in the first six to twelve months. Individual results vary.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: What it covers
hits.text:
## What it covers
The guarantee covers AlgaeCal Plus taken together with Strontium Boost (sold together as the Bone Builder Pack). AlgaeCal basic, Collagen, D3 Complete, Magnesium Relax and Triple Power are not covered by the bone density guarantee. They fall under the one year money back policy instead.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.

The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium
hits.text:
## Strontium
Strontium Boost is strontium citrate, not the prescription drug strontium ranelate that was linked to heart risk in Europe. AlgaeCal's position is that strontium citrate has a different safety record. Customers with heart disease, kidney disease or blood clotting history should talk to their doctor before taking it.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium and DEXA
hits.text:
## Strontium and DEXA
Strontium is heavier than calcium, so once it is in the bone a DEXA scan reads higher than the real change in bone mineral. The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium
hits.text:
## Strontium
Strontium Boost is strontium citrate, not the prescription drug strontium ranelate that was linked to heart risk in Europe. AlgaeCal's position is that strontium citrate has a different safety record. Customers with heart disease, kidney disease or blood clotting history should talk to their doctor before taking it.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Strontium and DEXA
hits.text:
## Strontium and DEXA
Strontium is heavier than calcium, so once it is in the bone a DEXA scan reads higher than the real change in bone mineral. The company's FAQ says that if a scan shows a 10% increase, the strontium effect might account for a few percent of it. When a customer asks about this, say it plainly and point out that the guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured.

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Medication interactions people ask about
hits.text:
## Medication interactions people ask about
Levothyroxine (space four hours), bisphosphonates like Fosamax (customers often take both, ask them to involve their doctor), Prolia (same), blood thinners (vitamin K2 is in the product, so warfarin users must speak to their doctor first).

hits.title: Safety questions: strontium, DEXA readings, lead notice, side effects
hits.heading: Lead and heavy metals
hits.text:
## Lead and heavy metals
Every batch is third party tested for heavy metals. In September 2026 a California Proposition 65 notice was filed relating to lead in a product. Prop 65 thresholds are far below federal limits and many whole food calcium supplements carry the notice. Customer Care should acknowledge the notice, point to the batch testing, and not argue with the customer.

Louise,

Yes, it is true that strontium is heavier than calcium, which can cause a DEXA scan to read higher than the actual change in bone mineral. This is because the DEXA scan measures bone density, and strontium can make the bone appear denser even if it's not actually stronger.

To determine if your improvement is real, you should still follow up with your doctor or healthcare provider. They can assess your individual results and provide guidance on what changes are likely due to the strontium and what may be due to other factors.

The guarantee still applies to the scan result as measured, and we stand by the effectiveness of our product.

AlgaeCal Customer Care

## Common side effects
Digestive upset and constipation are the ones customers report most, usually from the magnesium or from taking all capsules at once. Splitting the dose and taking with food helps. Anything that feels serious: stop and see a doctor.

hits.text:
## How long until a scan shows change
The published studies and the guarantee both use six months as the minimum. Most follow up scans are 12 to 24 months apart because insurance pays for them on that schedule. Typical reported increases are 1% to 4% in the first six to twelve months. Individual results vary.

hits.text:
## Lead and heavy metals
Every batch is third party tested for heavy metals. In September 2026 a California Proposition 65 notice was filed relating to lead in a product. Prop 65 thresholds are far below federal limits and many whole food calcium supplements carry the notice. Customer Care should acknowledge the notice, point to the batch testing, and not argue with the customer.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: How to claim
hits.text:
## How to claim
Contact Customer Care by phone (1-800-820-0184) or email (support@algaecal.com) with both DEXA reports. The refund is for AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost purchased from AlgaeCal between the two scan dates.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The promise
hits.text:
## The promise
If a customer takes AlgaeCal Plus and Strontium Boost at the full recommended dose for at least six consecutive months and their follow up DEXA scan does not show an increase in bone density in either the hip or the spine, AlgaeCal refunds every penny paid for those two products between the two scans. The promise repeats scan to scan for as long as the customer keeps taking both products as directed.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: What it covers
hits.text:
## What it covers
The guarantee covers AlgaeCal Plus taken together with Strontium Boost (sold together as the Bone Builder Pack). AlgaeCal basic, Collagen, D3 Complete, Magnesium Relax and Triple Power are not covered by the bone density guarantee. They fall under the one year money back policy instead.

hits.title: Stronger Bones For Life guarantee
hits.heading: The three steps
hits.text:
## The three steps
1. Baseline scan. The customer needs a DEXA scan that is not more than 30 days old when they start. If their last scan is older than 30 days, the guaranteed period starts from their next scan.
2. Full dose for six months or more. Both products, every day, at the dose on the label, for at least six consecutive months and then until the follow up scan. It does not matter if the follow up is at six, twelve or twenty four months as long as the full dose continued between scans.
3. Follow up scan at the same clinic, ideally on the same machine, so the two scans are directly comparable.
